Watch: Keep an eye on the semiconductor names and broader tech indices.

plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this leveraged ETF given its significant loss and decay.
SPAL: Evaluate reducing exposure to this leveraged ETF due to its large unrealized loss.
